{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
df_filtered = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = df_filtered['customer_age'].mean()

print(f'Number of rows with valid age: {len(df_filtered)}')
print(f'Mean age of customers with valid age: {mean_age:.2f} years')"}
